course_name_original: Projekt Formula Student Electric: Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Bau und Erprobung eines Rennfahrzeugs
course_name_en: Formula Student Electric Project: Development, Design, Construction, and Testing of a Racing Vehicle

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the currently valid regulations for the development of a racing vehicle.
Describe the complex interactions between the assemblies, functions, and systems of the vehicle.
Apply scientific methods from engineering or computer science for the development and testing of components, functions, and systems of vehicles and successfully demonstrate this with an example.
Apply the necessary coordination structures within the development team and the required forms of interdisciplinary collaboration, also for successful teamwork, in practice.
Apply the competencies acquired during studies to analyze a complex technical task and successfully work on it in a team over a semester.
Develop and maintain the IT systems used in the backend.
Develop and test control units for electric vehicles.
Develop and test software for autonomous driving functions.
Convincingly present project results to an audience.

Concisely and in writing present the task, analysis, solution concept, implementation, and verification of a complex technical problem, including independent definition of the topic area in cooperation with Schanzer Racing and the supervising professor.

syllabus_topics: Analysis, modeling of electrical engineering, mechatronic, and information technology components, functions, and systems of vehicles
Development of electrical engineering, mechatronic, and information technology components, functions, and systems of vehicles
Testing, verification, and documentation of electrical engineering, mechatronic, and information technology components, functions, and systems of vehicles
Fundamentals of networked and interdisciplinary work
Fundamentals of success and progress control
Topic selection is made according to the competencies from respective study programs
assessment_rules: The proof of performance is based on an oral examination (15-30 minutes) and semester-long work on the project, including project documentation, a project presentation, and a product that is realized and presented at the end of the semester. Active participation in the Formula Student Team Schanzer Racing is mandatory, and membership in Schanzer Racing Electric is a prerequisite for participation in this project.
